title: M/s Forntier Alloy Steels Ltd. v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. & 2 Others
coram: Vineet Saran, J. & Attau Rahman Masoodi, J.
disposition: Interim order — licensee restrained from demanding additional security pending the petition
headnote: Interim order only. A demand for additional security under Clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was challenged; following an earlier interim order granted in a similar matter (Supreme Ceramics Limited v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.), and identical questions being involved in several matters, the Court, without prejudice to the parties' rights and contentions, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security from the petitioner until further orders, and directed the petition be connected and listed with the lead matter. No final view on the validity of the additional-security demand was expressed.

holding_units.topic: Additional-security demand — interim restraint pending adjudication
holding_units.question: (Interim) Should the licensee be restrained from enforcing an additional-security demand under Clause 4.20 pending the challenge?
holding_units.holding: Interim relief granted: following the interim order in the similar Supreme Ceramics matter and as identical questions are involved in several cases, the respondents are restrained, without prejudice to the parties' contentions, from demanding additional security from the petitioner until further orders; the petition is to be connected and heard with the lead matter.
holding_units.flag: Interim order only — no final holding on the validity of the Clause 4.20 additional-security demand; connected to the Supreme Ceramics batch.

not_decided.point: Validity of the additional-security demand under Clause 4.20
